title: 第13章 三位师兄第14章 这样的日子真好
slug: 满级师妹她缺德但能打
content_zh:
光门稳定，光华流转，通往生路的通道已然畅通。
然而，秘境入口处却陷入了一片诡异的寂静。
所有青云宗弟子都如同被施了定身术，目光死死地盯着那抹收回手的蓝色身影，大脑一片空白。
修…修好了？就那么轻轻一按？那即将崩溃、连林风啸等炼气后期弟子合力都无法维持的秘境入口，就这么…被云杳杳随手修好了？！
这已经完全超出了他们的理解范畴！
这根本不是炼气期修士能做到的事情！
甚至筑基、金丹长老也未必能如此轻描淡写地稳定一个濒临崩溃的小秘境入口！
这位杳杳师姐师叔…究竟是什么怪物？！
云杳杳却仿佛只是做了一件微不足道的小事，拍了拍手上并不存在的灰尘，对着呆滞的众人扬了扬下巴：“都傻站着干嘛？等着魔修再杀回来吗？赶紧走啊！”
她语气轻松，甚至带着点催促，仿佛刚才只是修好了一扇漏风的破木门。
众人这才如梦初醒，压下心中的惊涛骇浪，争先恐后地冲向光门。
此刻逃命要紧，无数的疑问只能暂时压在心底。
张远、李薇、王默紧紧跟在云杳杳身后，随着人流踏出光门。
重返宗门广场，感受到熟悉而平稳的天地灵气，所有人都有种劫后余生的恍惚感。
广场上，各峰长老早已严阵以待，显然也察觉到了秘境的异常和魔修的袭击。
见弟子们陆续安全返回，皆是松了口气，但看到不少人带伤，气氛依旧凝重。
“速清点人数！”
“受伤弟子立刻送往丹峰救治！”
“执法殿弟子，随我去探查秘境入口残留痕迹！”
一道道命令迅速下达。

云杳杳走出光门，双脚踩在坚实的广场青石板上，心中那根紧绷的弦微微一松。
然而，就在这放松的瞬间——
一股无法形容的、源自灵魂最深处的极致疲惫感，如同积攒了万年的潮水，轰然席卷而来！
她眼前猛地一黑，身体晃了晃，耳边所有的嘈杂声瞬间远去，变得模糊不清。
‘糟了…’她心中只来得及闪过这两个字。
动用创世源息，哪怕只是微不足道的一丝，用于稳定规则层面，其消耗的也绝非普通灵力，而是更深层次的灵魂本源之力。
她刚刚继承这份力量，尚未完全磨合适应，加之之前觉醒记忆、融合源核的消耗，此刻放松下来，反噬便如排山倒海般涌至！
“师姐！”
“云师叔！”
她听到张远三人惊恐的呼喊，感觉到有人扶住了她软倒的身体，但她的意识已经迅速沉入一片无边的黑暗之中，彻底失去了知觉。
在彻底昏迷前，最后一个模糊的念头划过她的心间：‘选我…是不是正因为我是冥主…不死不灭…可以永远承担这份职责…再无更替…就像…永恒的苦役…’
…………
云杳杳感觉自己仿佛在无尽的混沌中漂浮了许久。
没有时间的概念，没有空间的感知，只有一片温暖的、黑暗的宁静。
灵魂深处那过度消耗带来的撕裂感，在这片宁静中缓缓被抚平、滋养。
content_en:
The door of light is stable, the light is flowing, and the passage to life is open.
However, there was an eerie silence at the entrance to the secret realm.
All the Qingyun Sect disciples seemed to have been cast a restraining spell, their eyes fixed on the blue figure who withdrew his hand, their minds went blank.
Repair...fixed? Just a tap? The entrance to the secret realm that was about to collapse, and even the combined efforts of Lin Fengxiao and other late-stage Qi-refining disciples could not maintain it, was just... repaired by Yun Yaoyao? !
This is completely beyond their understanding!
This is simply not something that a monk in the Qi Refining Stage can do!
Even the foundation builders and golden elixir elders may not be able to stabilize the entrance to a small secret realm that is on the verge of collapse so easily!
This senior sister and uncle Yao Yao... what kind of monster is this? !
However, Yun Yaoyao seemed to have just done a trivial thing. He patted the non-existent dust on his hands and raised his chin to the stunned crowd: "Why are you standing there stupidly? Are you waiting for the demon cultivator to come back? Hurry up and leave!"
Her tone was relaxed, even a little urging, as if she had just repaired a broken wooden door that was leaking.
Everyone just woke up from a dream, suppressed the turmoil in their hearts, and rushed towards the light door.
At this moment, it was important to escape, and countless questions could only be temporarily suppressed in my heart.
Zhang Yuan, Li Wei, and Wang Mo followed closely behind Yun Yaoyao and followed the flow of people out of the light door.
Returning to Zongmen Square, feeling the familiar and stable aura of heaven and earth, everyone felt like they were in a trance after a disaster.
In the square, the elders from all the peaks had already been prepared, and they were obviously aware of the anomalies in the secret realm and the attack of the demonic cultivators.
Seeing the disciples returning safely one after another, they all breathed a sigh of relief, but seeing many people injured, the atmosphere was still solemn.
"Count the number of people quickly!"
"The injured disciple is immediately sent to Danfeng for treatment!"
"Disciples of the Law Enforcement Hall, follow me to explore the remaining traces of the entrance to the secret realm!"
Orders were issued quickly.
Yun Yaoyao walked out of the light door, stepped on the solid bluestone of the square, and the tight string in his heart relaxed slightly.
However, in this moment of relaxation——
An indescribable feeling of ultimate exhaustion, originating from the deepest part of the soul, swept over me like a tide that had accumulated for thousands of years!
Her vision suddenly went dark, her body swayed, and all the noise in her ears instantly faded away and became blurry.
'Oops...' She only had time to flash these two words in her mind.
Using the source of creation, even if it is only an insignificant trace, to stabilize the rule level, it consumes not ordinary spiritual power, but the deeper power of the soul.
She had just inherited this power and had not yet fully adapted to it. Coupled with the previous consumption of awakening memories and fusing the source core, now that she relaxed, the backlash came like an overwhelming force!
"Senior sister!"
"Uncle Yun!"
She heard the frightened shouts of Zhang Yuan and the others, and felt someone supporting her limp body, but her consciousness had quickly sunk into boundless darkness and she completely lost consciousness.
Before she was completely unconscious, the last vague thought passed through her heart: 'Choose me... is it because I am the Lord of the Underworld... immortal... and can bear this responsibility forever... no replacement... just like... eternal hard labor...'
…………
Yun Yaoyao felt as if she had been floating in endless chaos for a long time.
There is no concept of time, no perception of space, just a warm, dark silence.
The tearing feeling caused by excessive consumption deep in the soul is slowly healed and nourished in this tranquility.
